shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat AGENTS.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text Alert && rg -n -C 2 'Required setup|ThemeProvider|styles.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(TextInput|Select|Switch|Checkbox|Avatar|Button|Alert|Text)/.*d.ts"'$'"' | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'spacing|border-radius|utility|positive|info|background|generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -100 && cat tsconfig.json && rg --files -g '*lock*' -g '"'!node_modules'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text Alert; rg -n -C 2 'Required setup|ThemeProvider|styles.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(TextInput|Select|Switch|Checkbox|Avatar|Button|Alert|Text)/.*d.ts"'$'"' | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,195p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts; sed -n '25,75p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg 'File|Upload'; rg -n -- '--g-color-base-(utility|float|simple)|--g-color-text-(utility|light)|--g-color-line-utility|--g-border-radius-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts; rg -n -A 65 'interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/i18n'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -L --max-time 20 -s https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && rg -o '\"(Person|Globe|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUpFromSquare|CircleQuestion|ChevronRight|Check|ArrowRight|Gear|CircleCheck|ArrowUpFromLine|Lock)[A-Za-z]*\"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u | head -50; rg -n -A 12 '## I18n' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for(const p of ['icons','i18n']) console.log(p,require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)\"; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/AvatarText.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"const html=await (await fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons')).text(); const names=[...new Set(html.match(/(?:Person|Globe|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUpFrom|CircleQuestion|ChevronRight|Check|ArrowRight|Gear|CircleCheck|Lock)[A-Za-z]*/g))]; console.log(names.join('\\n'))\"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; rg -n 'configure' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; rg -n -- '--g-color-line-(generic|focus)|--g-color-base-(background|generic)|--g-color-text-(complementary|brand|inverted)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Person|Globe|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUpFrom|CircleQuestion|ChevronRight|CircleCheck|ArrowRight|Lock|Xmark|Check' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat; rg -n -C 2 -- '--g-avatar|background|color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css | head -55; rg -n -C 2 -- '--g-button-padding|--g-button-text-color|--g-button-text-color-hover' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -55; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.js; rg -n 'CircleExclamation|Clock' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -n -- '--g-spacing-[4-9]:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && npm run build'
